messages:
elaine: Quick prep check for tomorrow's live event (10:00 AM PT). I pushed the latest reg page -- need final sign-off on copy, Zoom settings, recording plan, and lead routing. Link: https://rwd.ai/events/llm-live-demo?utm_campaign=llm-launch&utm_source=slack

matt: looks good overall. copy tweak suggestion in the CTA: change 'Join the demo' -> 'Save my spot & get replay' to help capture emails for follow-up.

jordan: +1 on CTA. Also can we add a hidden field on the reg form for utm_medium=webinar so analytics already tags leads?

elaine: yes adding utm_medium now. jordan can you confirm the HubSpot form mapping will pick that up?

jordan: will do. mapping note: send utm_* -> contact properties. I’ll also add a dropdown for company size (small/med/large) so SDRs have quick qual context.

rei: Zoom setup: we should run as a Zoom webinar (not meeting) — need panelists added and Q&A enabled. Recording: cloud, speaker view, and automatic transcription enabled. Also enable "Only authenticated users can join"? that might block corporate attendees.

elaine: don’t force auth. We want low friction. Keep Q&A + chat open. Can we set registration so only people who register get the webinar link (auto email)?

matt: yes standard Zoom webinar flow will email registrants the join link. Make sure the confirmation email has replay expectations + 1-2 sentence product teaser and the one-click calendar add.

elaine: drafting confirmation email now. Draft snippet: "Thanks — your seat is saved. We'll send a replay to attendees and registrants within 24 hours. Add to your calendar: [Add to Calendar]." Thoughts?

jordan: add CTA to reply with questions they want covered. Good for future content.

rei: Recording retention: ops wants recordings in central GCS bucket and a trimmed version (3–5 min) for socials. Ops-bot can we trigger a post-recording workflow to S3/GCS + create a short clip task?

ops-bot: @rei noted. We'll run post-recording job: 1) export cloud recording (speaker view), 2) copy to gs://redwood-recordings/2026-03-xx/, 3) create task in #content-prod with link for editor.

elaine: perfect. also need captions — auto transcription is fine for now but tag as "auto" in asset metadata so editors can correct.

matt: lead routing — desired flow: 1) registrant -> HubSpot contact + lifecycle stage = lead, 2) attenders -> HubSpot property "attended=true", 3) high-engagement (asked Q or watched >50%) -> SDR queue. We have existing zap that sends HubSpot events; do we want to keep Zapier or direct webhook?

jordan: prefer direct webhook to avoid zap delays. I can add a serverless webhook endpoint that writes to HubSpot and flags segments.

elaine: timeline: jordan, can you deliver webhook by EOD? If not we fallback to Zapier.

jordan: small function ready, need env keys. will deploy by 6pm PT.

rei: tracking: add these events -> webinar_registered, webinar_attended, webinar_qa. Use JSON payload with email, utm_campaign, utm_medium, company_size, attended (true/false), watch_pct. Schema snippet for analytics team: ```{ "email": "...", "utm_campaign": "llm-launch", "utm_medium": "webinar", "company_size": "mid", "attended": true, "watch_pct": 82 }```

elaine: copy for post-event email (send at T+24h): short thank you, link to replay (gated for registrants), 1-sheet with benchmark highlights, CTA to request dedicated runbook/benchmark for their workload. Draft coming shortly.

matt: for replay gating — we should send replay link to all registrants but provide an unlisted public clip for socials. Keep full replay behind registration for lead capture.

rei: accessibility note: include link to transcript and plain-text slide deck in follow-up email.

ops-bot: deploy reminder: Zoom webinar scheduled, panelists invited, cloud recording toggled ON, transcript ON. Automated reminder emails set: 24h, 1h, 10m.

elaine: action items summary: @jordan -> webhook + hubspot mapping (EOD), @matt -> final confirmation email copy + calendar add, @rei -> confirm Zoom panelists + run checklist during rehearsal, @ops-bot -> post-recording export + clip task. I'll compile and send final checklist in #marketing-ops.

matt: i’ll update the confirmation and send to you for review by 4pm PT. :thumbsup:

jordan: webhook deployed to staging. sending test payload shortly.

elaine: thanks team — rehearsal set for today 4:30pm PT. please be on for 15 min run-through. :raised_hands:
